evidence_items.explanation: The study compares twenty-five models and four prompting techniques on original questions and controlled variants, finding competent original-task performance alongside failures on altered tasks. It also reports relative resilience to some numerical and wording changes, consistent with Marcus's qualification that small changes cause failures only sometimes.
